In [[3954 BBY]] a '''skirmish''' took place outside of [[Darth Nyriss]]' [[Darth Nyriss's stronghold|stronghold]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. After the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] arrived at Nyriss' stronghold [[Gender/Legends|he]] was attacked by [[Unidentified female mercenary (Dromund Kaas)|two]] [[Unidentified male mercenary (Dromund Kaas)|mercenaries]]. During the brief battle both [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|A thousand apologies, my lord. Some Subjugates lack a proper understanding of our customs.|Sechel, about the mercenaries|<ref name="Revan" />}}
In [[3954 BBY]] after the [[Assassination attempts on Darth Nyriss|second attempt]] on her life [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Nyriss]] hired [[Unidentified female mercenary (Dromund Kaas)|two]] [[Unidentified male mercenary (Dromund Kaas)|mercenaries]] to follow up a lead that [[Gender/Legends|her]] security [[Chief/Legends|chief]] [[Murtog]] and her [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] [[Sechel]] discovered. Before they could do their job the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] intervened forcing Nyriss to ask the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] for help. After Scourge's arrival on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] she had Sechel escort him to her stronghold and also order the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Sith Lord.<ref name="Revan" />

==Skirmish==
{{Quote|Tell me who hired you and I'll let you live.''"<br />"''Do I look that stupid?''"<br />"''You're obviously skilled. I can use someone like you. Tell me who hired you, and I'll let you work for me. That, or throw your life away.|Scourge and the female mercenary|<ref name="Revan" />}}
Shortly after arriving at Nyriss' stronghold a speeder, containing the mercenaries, opened fire on Scourge forcing him to [[Force speed/Legends|flee]] and take cover behind the [[Statue of the Sith Emperor|statue]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. As the speeder attempted to make a second strafing run, Scourge stepped out and [[Telekinesis/Legends#Saber throw|threw]] his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] at the speeder damaging the back end. Shortly after the speeder clipped the statue he was hiding behind and crash landed. The Sith Lord charged the disoriented male as the female drew her [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] and opened fire on the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] in an attempt to cover her partner. In response Scourge [[Force jump/Legends|leapt]] over the damaged speeder and slew the male mercenary before he could open fire with his [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].<ref name="Revan" />

In retaliation for her partners' death she fired another barrage at the Sith and managed to clip his shoulder. In anger Scourge unleashed a [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force wave|force wave]] that blasted her into a nearby statue. After regaining her balance she pulled out an [[electrorod]], while dropping into a fighting crouch. As they circled each other Scourge offered her a chance to live in exchange for the identity of the person who hired them. Before she could make a decision, she was shot by Nyriss's security chief and five [[Security guard/Legends|guards]].<ref name="Revan" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Clean this mess up.|Murtog|<ref name="Revan" />}}
After the skirmish Nyriss revealed to Scourge that she hired the mercenaries to follow a lead pertaining to the recent attacks on her life and she was left with an excess of agents after the Emperor's interference. She advised Scourge to think of the skirmish as a test stating that had he failed he would have been unworthy to server her, just as if he succeeded he would have proved that they were a waste of resources, either way leaving her with the perfect candidate for the job. After the revelation she told him about the lead and that the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that almost killed her during the second attack on her life came from a [[Uxiol Droid Manufacturing plant|plant]] on the planet [[Hallion]]. She sent Scourge and Sechel on a [[Mission to Hallion|mission]] to infiltrate the the plant and discovered who purchased the droid.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The skirmish first appeared in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'' which was released on [[November 15]], [[2011]].
